name: Kleister Charity: Key Information Extraction from Long Financial Reports
description: Kleister Charity is an open benchmark dataset for key information extraction from long, complex financial and operational annual reports. Sourced from the UK Charity Commission public registry by Applica.ai, Kleister Charity comprises 2,778 multi-page PDF documents spanning a total of 61,643 pages (averaging 22.2 pages per document, with maximum page lengths reaching up to 100+ pages). The extraction task focuses on 8 core charity entities: charity address, charity name, charity registration number, annual income, and annual spending (in GBP). The dataset benchmark evaluates handling of highly varied document formats, multipage tabular breakdowns, diverse visual templates, and challenging OCR extraction noise.
